materials.name: Structural Steel S355
materials.notes: Common structural steel; weldable, widely available.

materials.name: Aluminium 7075-T6
materials.notes: High-strength aluminium; lower corrosion resistance than 6061.

materials.name: Titanium Ti-6Al-4V
materials.notes: High strength-to-weight; aerospace and medical use.

materials.name: Copper C11000 (ETP)
materials.notes: Excellent electrical and thermal conductivity; annealed.

materials.name: Magnesium AZ31B
materials.notes: Lightest structural metal; needs corrosion protection.

materials.name: Carbon Fibre / Epoxy (quasi-isotropic laminate)
materials.notes: Laminate properties depend strongly on layup; yield not applicable — use tensile / allowable instead.

materials.name: PLA (3D-print filament)
materials.notes: Common FDM printing polymer; brittle, low heat resistance.

materials.name: ABS
materials.notes: Tough thermoplastic; widely used for housings and prototypes.
